title: The Recipe of Maple Street
author: Ines Nystrom
blurb: Rafael Dunmore, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
